# `apprafter db`

Manage SharedDatabase CRs — a PostgreSQL database or a Redis keyspace several Applications bind, each with its own credential and its own access level. Databases are namespaced and outlive every application bound to them; `rm` is refused while any application is still bound

```text
Usage: apprafter db <COMMAND>
```

Subcommands:

- [`apprafter db create`](#apprafter-db-create) — Create a SharedDatabase CR in the cluster
- [`apprafter db list`](#apprafter-db-list) — List SharedDatabases with their type, refCount and backing
- [`apprafter db rm`](#apprafter-db-rm) — Delete a SharedDatabase and its data.
- [`apprafter db status`](#apprafter-db-status) — Show detail for one SharedDatabase, including who is bound to it

## `apprafter db create`

Create a SharedDatabase CR in the cluster

```text
Usage: apprafter db create [OPTIONS] --type <TYPE> <NAME>
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<NAME>` | yes | SharedDatabase `metadata.name` (DNS-1123) |

| Flag | Value | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--extension` | — | — | no | PostgreSQL extension to create in the database. Repeatable. Bounded by the platform's allow list; `pg` only |
| `--namespace`, `-n` | — | `default` | no | Target namespace. Applications may only bind a database in their OWN namespace, so this is the namespace of the applications that will share it |
| `--persistent` | flag | — | no | Keep the data across the CR's deletion. `redis` only |
| `--size` | — | — | no | Size class passed through to the backend (e.g. `small`) |
| `--type` | `pg` \| `redis` | — | yes | `pg` or `redis` |

## `apprafter db list`

List SharedDatabases with their type, refCount and backing

```text
Usage: apprafter db list [OPTIONS]
```

Aliases: `ls` — accepted on the command line, not listed in `--help`.

| Flag | Value | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--namespace`, `-n` | — | — | no | Namespace to list. Omit for cluster-wide listing |

## `apprafter db rm`

Delete a SharedDatabase and its data. Refused while any application is still bound

```text
Usage: apprafter db rm [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<NAME>` | yes | SharedDatabase `metadata.name` |

| Flag | Value | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--namespace`, `-n` | — | `default` | no | Namespace |
| `--yes` | flag | — | no | Skip the confirmation prompt |

Show detail for one SharedDatabase, including who is bound to it

```text
Usage: apprafter db status [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<NAME>` | yes | SharedDatabase `metadata.name` |
